governing_document: Kerala Municipality Building Rules (KMBR) & Kerala ECBC
authority: Local Self Government Department, Govt of Kerala
climate_adaptations: Warm & Humid with heavy monsoon rainfall.
Mandatory roof slope and gutter drainage provisions.
Traditional courtyard and verandas for passive dehumidification.

rules.description: Pitched roofs in heavy rainfall zones must maintain a minimum slope of 20 degrees with waterproof underlayment.
rules.remediation: Increase roof pitch to at least 20 degrees for rapid stormwater runoff.
